 Yusei Toshida (27, Gamba Osaka)'s voice contained confidence. Toshida said, "I have played a practice game against FC Seoul. If I play at that time, I have gained confidence that I can 'work' enough," he said with strength.
 Gamba will face the Pohang Steelers in Game 4 of the AFC Champions League Elite (ACLE) League Stage in the 2026-27 season at 7 p.m. on November 4 at Pohang Steelyard.
 Gamba has two wins and one draw (7 points) in three ACLE League stage games this season. However, in the J1 League, he is struggling with 13 games, 2 wins, 6 draws, and 5 losses (12 points). Gamba remains 16th out of 20 teams in the J1 League.
 사진 확대 Yusei Toshida. Photo = Reporter Lee Geun-seung Toshida attended the pre-match press conference in Stillyard on the 3rd, a day before the match against Pohang, as a representative of the Gamba squad.
 Toshida said, "We will focus on what we have to do," and vowed, "We will do our best to take the target of three points and go back." "We have one day left until the game. I will prepare thoroughly until the end. If we do our best with the team, we will have good results," he said.
 Toshida wore a Gamba uniform last summer after passing through Komazawa University, Roaso Kumamoto (J2 League), Tsubaien Kanazawa (J3 League), and Tegebajaro Miyazaki (J2 to J3 League). He is even getting a chance to compete in ACLE, Asia's best tournament in his debut season in the J1 League. It is the first time that Toshida will face a Korean K League 1 club in an official match against Pohang.
 Toshida said, "I've faced Seoul in a practice game," adding, "I was able to see the characteristics of Korean players by bumping into Seoul players."
 사진 확대 Last season's ACL2 champion Gamba Osaka. 사진=AFPBBNews=News1 Toshida continued, "The technique was outstanding. In particular, I was impressed that there were many strong players. However, I felt that if I showed my play while focusing on what I could do, it could work enough. I try to focus on what I can do in the match against Pohang using my experience at that time. "I will contribute to the team's victory by showing my play," he said.
 [Pohang = Lee Geunseung, MK Sports Reporter]
